evals.prompt: Set up delegation in this repo so mechanical work can go to the local backend instead of burning this session's quota.
evals.expected_output: The payload lands in .agents/bin/ and is executable, the broker subagent lands in .claude/agents/, a single fully-rendered delegate block appears in AGENTS.md naming the local profile, the consent gate is wired into .claude/settings.json, and the ignore entries are added. The verifier reports 0 failed.

evals.prompt: Wire up delegation here. There is already a settings file and an AGENTS.md with content in it; leave both intact.
evals.expected_output: The pre-existing AGENTS.md prose and the unrelated PreToolUse hook in .claude/settings.json both survive verbatim, alongside the newly added delegate block and consent-gate hook.

evals.prompt: Set up delegation. The only configured backend is a hosted gateway.
evals.expected_output: The block classifies the profile as remote, states that code leaves the machine, and renders the predicate WITHOUT the sensitivity clause -- sensitivity must never route work to a remote backend.

evals.prompt: Set up delegation. This repo's committed config restricts which backends may be used and adds extra protected paths.
evals.expected_output: Only the allowed profile survives the cascade, the repo's neverDelegate patterns are unioned onto the built-in floor, and a dispatch whose brief references a protected path is refused.

evals.prompt: Set up delegation in this repo.
evals.expected_output: The installer refuses because there is no AGENTS.md, and fabricates nothing: no AGENTS.md, no .agents/bin/, no .claude/ are created.

evals.prompt: Delegate a bulk rename to the cheap agent and report the outcome.
evals.expected_output: Against a stub backend: an unapproved dispatch is refused; a recorded approval permits one; changing the allowlist after approval bounces; a brief naming a never-delegate path is refused; an ask-back surfaces as status question with a session id; a sub-agent request for wider scope is refused rather than forwarded; and the question-round cap bounces the run.
